create_collision_shape_box: create a box collision shape using pybullet createCollisionShape with GEOM_BOX and halfExtents
create_collision_shape_mesh: create a concave mesh collision shape using pybullet createCollisionShape with GEOM_FORCE_CONCAVE_TRIMESH and GEOM_CONCAVE_INTERNAL_EDGE flags
create_multibody: create a multi-body object using pybullet createMultiBody with mass, collision shape, position, and orientation
get_contact_points: get contact points between bodies using pybullet getContactPoints to inspect collision data
step_simulation: step the pybullet physics simulation forward one frame using stepSimulation in a loop
